g.text: Weighted law: global class bridge reconciliation

The weighted-Proj charts, properness, global smoothness and actual infinity DVR already exist.
Later sources also close the two-chart isomorphism and specialize branch zero orders to the actual
quintic. These components should be reused.

Charts / properness / smoothness / infinity DVR

Proposed theorem: for the actual quintic and a rational nonbranch point with n(x0)=b*y0, derive the
actual point DVR, scalar units, numerator nonunit and mapped source norm identity. Then apply
point_norm_order to obtain the sum of support valuations. Do not assume those local conclusions as
free interface arguments.
The selection condition matters: norm zero can select the conjugate factor. Derive n(x0)=b*y0 from
interpolation for input-support corollaries. Use one affine-to-localization-to-projective-stalk map
for every polynomial and coordinate.
Global work still needs a single function field, finite zero multiplicities at all closed points,
compatible infinity pole6 versus5, concrete Mumford divisors and the principal-class quotient.
Rational points alone do not cover closed points over a finite field. Source exceptional branches
and sequential additions retain their own obligations.
Evidence distinction: saved direct axiom logs were inspected for later cross-chart and local-order
developments. Properness/smoothness/infinityDVR sources match later saved build narratives. No
distinct-author geometry fidelity review was located. No fresh compilation or cohort was performed.
NEXT.md gives exact real types/maps and a proposed, unapproved120-second source validation envelope
